narrationTexts: Confirmed. Fixing both call sites to match the new options shape.
finalText:
**Build's clean, exit 0.**

Two real bugs behind the noise, both from the bundler bump changing option shapes:

- [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined` flags since the old loader used to send `false`. Simplified to a plain `=== true` check.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from Node/lockfile changes, not errors.

Next: nothing.
